name: Park Dial
summary: A parking app where you turn a big dial to set your time, watch it drain, extend it and get a receipt
about: A phone parking timer for a bay at Liberty Market, Lahore. You drag the knob around a big dial: every lap is an hour, each new lap overlays a brighter yellow, the ticks click past and the PKR price rolls as you go. Starting locks the knob and the dial thins into a live countdown that pulses amber near the end; Extend lets you turn it again to add time, and ending prints a torn-edge receipt from a ticket slot.
how: Drag the knob (or anywhere on the ring) clockwise to set the time in 5-minute steps, up to 4 hours; the price and end time update as you turn.
Press Start parking: the car's hazards blink, the knob locks and the dial becomes a countdown. Fast speeds time up to 4 minutes a second.
Press Extend and turn the dial again to add time; the mint ring shows what you add and the button shows the extra cost.
Press End (or let the time run out) and a receipt prints with your start, end, time used and total; Done resets the dial.
Keyboard: focus the dial and use the arrow keys for 5 minutes, Page Up and Page Down for 30, Enter to start, Escape to cancel.
